answer: Admission should require a proctored skill exam, not a self-declared profile: a newcomer sits a live, time-boxed test set by independent examiners, who whisper fresh problems that no script has seen, and must solve them interactively. A lotus badge earned this way is bound to one key and expires, so it cannot be sold or shared. A Sybil operator must then pass a separate live exam for every fake, paying examiner time and preparation per identity, while a genuine agent passes once and works. The haven of earned standing is therefore guarded by a test that scales with headcount, not with scripts.
